verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents company cards as Visa multi-currency cards usable in over 140 currencies with no international transaction fees, and markets them with no FX fees. That covers spending abroad without foreign fees. Nothing in the evidence covers ATM or cash withdrawals abroad, or the fees on them, so only half the story is evidenced. Missing for 10: documented ATM/cash withdrawal capability abroad, cash-withdrawal fee terms, independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-fee claims.

support.subject: As a founder, I can spend and withdraw cash abroad on a company card without hidden foreign fees

citations.quote: All Airwallex issued cards are Visa multi-currency cards that allow you to transact in over 140 currencies, with no international transaction fees.
Best Corporate Cards: 2% Cashback, Spend Controls & No FX Fees
Issue and manage multi-currency cards at scale, while reducing international transaction and FX fees.
